identificationModule.briefTitle: LUME-Columbus: Nintedanib Plus Docetaxel in Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer With Translational Research
identificationModule.officialTitle: Multicentre, Randomised, Double-blind, Phase III Trial to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Oral Nintedanib Plus Docetaxel Therapy Compared to Placebo Plus Docetaxel Therapy in Patients With Stage IIIB/IV or Recurrent, Adenocarcinoma Subtype Non-small Cell Lung Cancer After Failure of First Line Chemotherapy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The present trial will investigate the efficacy and safety of nintedanib in combination with docetaxel as compared to placebo in combination with docetaxel in patients with stage IIIB/IV or recurrent NSCLC of adenocarcinoma histology after failure of first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.

armGroups.label: Docetaxel and placebo
armGroups.description: patients to receive backbone chemotherapy and placebo

armGroups.label: Docetaxel and Nintedanib
armGroups.description: patients to receive backbone chemotherapy and nintedanib

primaryOutcomes.measure: Disease Control According to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours (RECIST), Version 1.1
primaryOutcomes.description: This outcome measure presents the number of patients with disease control according to RECIST, version 1.1, defined as number of patients with Complete response, partial response or stable disease.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Male or female patients of at least 18 years of age
* Histologically confirmed, adenocarcinoma of the lung, after failure of first line platinum-based chemotherapy.

Exclusion criteria:

* More than one prior line of chemotherapy (i.e., 2nd or 3rd line chemotherapy) for advanced and/or metastatic (stage III B or IV NSCLC) or recurrent disease.
* Patients known to be positive for activating Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) mutation or anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) translocation
* Previous therapy with other vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) or VEGFR inhibitors (other than bevacizumab) or docetaxel for the treatment of NSCLC at any time
* Prior monotherapy with an EGFR inhibitor except as maintenance therapy
